lines: Mind the grindstone. What do you need?
Step clear of the wheel and speak up.
Set any weapon down before you explain.
There you are. Need an edge checked?
Morning. The forge has already been awake for hours.
Keep your hands clear of the wheel. I am listening.
I have a moment before the steel heats.
What happened to the weapon this time?
If this is about a nick, show me. If it is gossip, spare me.
Go on. The hammer can wait one minute.
Do not lean on the bench. That is where the sharp things live.
You came in calmly, so I assume nothing broke on the way here.
Tell me what you need before I start guessing at repairs.
The blade is cooling. Make this quick.
I am listening, but the grindstone is not. Speak up.
Leave some room by the forge and we will get along.
You look like someone with damaged steel or damaged pride.
One problem at a time. Which one did you bring?
If you need advice, expect it to be as blunt as the hammer.
Alright. Show me what needs work.
